question: How do I turn on Simple Mode?
answer: You can turn on Simple Mode by tapping the 'Normal / Simple' eye button in the top right corner of the header. It enlarges text and buttons for easier reading.
simple_answer: Look at the top right of your screen. Tap the button that says 'Simple'. The buttons will get bigger and words will become very easy to read.
steps: Text and buttons will enlarge immediately
Tap it again anytime to switch back

question: How do I use voice to talk to SafePay?
answer: Tap the floating microphone or 'Ask SafePay' button at the bottom right. You can speak in English, Hindi, or Tamil and SafePay will understand and respond aloud.
simple_answer: Tap the purple microphone icon on your screen. When it turns blue, speak clearly. SafePay will listen, show what you said, and speak back.
steps: Confirm what you said on screen
SafePay will answer and guide you

question: What does this screen mean and what should I press?
answer: SafePay Assistant is screen-aware. It identifies whether you are on Home, Send Money, Payment Review, Messages, or Safety Center and points out the exact next step.
simple_answer: Tell me what screen you are looking at or ask 'What should I do?'. I will look at your screen and tell you the single right button to press next.
steps: I will highlight the recommended action
